title: Laugh Odds
tagline: Predict meme virality, vote gaslessly via Yellow Network, and earn rewards on internet's humor .
description: Laugh Odds is a Web3 meme prediction market where creators upload templates, voters stake on whether memes are funny or lame, and winners earn rewards. Powered by Yellow Network state channels for instant, gasless voting with automatic settlement every 6 hours turning internet humor into a real decentralized financial opportunity for everyone.
how_its_made: Laugh Odds is built on Next.js and Express.js with MongoDB for data storage. Smart contracts on Sepolia handle meme markets, while Yellow Network state channels enable gasless voting. IPFS via Pinata stores meme assets, and an automated cron-based settlement service distributes rewards every 6 hours.
